definitions.explanation: A person who undergoes testing or participates in a scientific experiment, clinical trial, or psychological study. Used in academic and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The experiment began after obtaining the subjects' consent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{臨床|りんしょう}→臨床：13975_rinshou⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧200⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Two hundred participants took part in this clinical trial.

notes:
Composed of {被|ひ} (to undergo, receive) + {験|けん} (test, examine) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to the person being tested or examined in a research setting. Common in academic papers, medical trials, and psychology studies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recruit test subjects
- {被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧: subject's consent
- {被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: subject number
- {被験者|ひけんしゃ}⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧: subject group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: experimental target — more general, can include non-human subjects
- ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧: participant — broader term used in surveys, events, and studies alike
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: patient — used in medical treatment contexts rather than research
